name: Entity Admin Handlers
description: Provides admin UIs for entity types via reusable entity route provider and links handlers.
project_description: The Entity Admin Handlers module provides an out-of-the-box admin UI for custom entity types whose configuration means that the admin UI code in Drupal core doesn't fit. It reduces the boilerplate needed to give an entity type and its bundles a Field UI management interface. It ships reusable entity-type handlers (route providers, links providers, and controllers) grouped into sets for different entity-type configurations, which a developer references from the entity type's annotation/attribute. Two sets are provided: Single bundle entity types (bundleless entity types that behave like the core user entity) and Plain bundle entity types (multiple bundles that are not backed by a config bundle entity, e.g. bundles from hook_entity_bundle_info() or Entity API bundle plugins). It depends on core Field UI. Full menu, task, and action links require the core patch at https://www.drupal.org/project/drupal/issues/2976861; the generated routes work without it.
